Motor cooling is excluded for the paper's 500 N case by assuming rotor heating has no effect.
Lee et al. assume the electric-pump cycle is driven by a single motor, the commercial BLDC motor Vishan EC2060L-3660 (0.875 kW/kg, 57,940 rpm, 87%, 80 g).
The study assumes battery energy efficiency is constant for its 600 s design case; this is not a general efficiency map.
This study assumes one motor drives the electric-pump arrangement; LREKit separately sizes two stream drives.
